input.quote: (a) Ono shall have the right (but not the obligation) to Manufacture and/or package, or engage a Subcontractor to Manufacture, Ono's requirements of particular Materials (e.g., Ono's requirements of Drug Substance or Ono's requirements of Drug Product of a particular Product) related to any Product for the Ono Territory.
input.rationale: The supply provisions in Article IX impose no sole-sourcing obligation on us: Section 9.4(a) expressly confirms our right (but not obligation) to Manufacture Materials ourselves or through a Subcontractor, and Section 9.4(b) makes obtaining commercial requirements from Array a right we may elect, not a commitment. Array's undertaking in Section 9.1(a) to supply or secure supply of our requirements runs in our favour. The only exclusivity in our favour is the exclusive licence under Article II, which benefits us. Section 8.2 ("Exclusivity of Efforts") is a mutual, product-category-limited non-compete on commercialising Competing Products (with an automatic exit if Array itself commercialises a Competing Product) rather than a sourcing/sole-supplier restriction, and it is the reciprocal of the exclusive licence we receive; it is noted rather than flagged under this rule. The clause set therefore meets the preferred position.
